wisdom from @clintgibler and @ky1ebot on how they've been helping secure the internet, finding unprecendented numbers of bugs in OSS and working with maintainers to get fixes upstreamed:

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Greg Brockman megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: OpenAI (@OpenAI); megjelent: 2026-11-23T23:25:45+00:00; link: https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2125007927098699827; média: videó, 717 másodperc]
In one run, GPT-6 Cyber helped us validate 948 Linux kernel bugs that could grant local root access and generate patches for review.

Our researchers @clintgibler and @ky1ebot share their findings and how they worked with maintainers to get fixes upstream.

Read the research: http://openai.com/index/a-thousand-fewer-paths-to-root/
